name: Audio description
overview: Finds and tags the films and series with a described sound track, plays it for the people who choose it, and adds a description track you have.
description: Audio description is a second sound track in which a narrator says what is happening, for blind and partially sighted people. This plug-in tags every film, episode and series with one as Audio description, and can put them in a collection, so every Jellyfin app can find them. Titles with audio description, a page beside its settings, lists every described film and episode, by series, each linking to its page. For each person who chooses it, it asks their app to play the described track. And it adds a description track you already have next to its film, after checking the lengths match.

versions.changelog:
### For Jellyfin 12

Added:

- Films to list and Series to list: on the settings page, under Titles with audio description, how many of each the Titles with audio description tab lists: All, or the last 10, 20, 50, 100 or 500 added to Jellyfin, newest first. Last 20 by default. A series counts by its newest described episode and still lists all its described episodes. Only that many are read from the library.
- The tab says how many it shows, such as "Showing the last 20 of 143 films and all 6 series, newest first", and where to change it.

Changed:

- Newest first: films and series are listed by when they were added to Jellyfin, newest first.

### For Jellyfin 10.11

Added:

- Films to list and Series to list: on the settings page, under Titles with audio description, how many of each the Titles with audio description tab lists: All, or the last 10, 20, 50, 100 or 500 added to Jellyfin, newest first. Last 20 by default. A series counts by its newest described episode and still lists all its described episodes. Only that many are read from the library.
- The tab says how many it shows, such as "Showing the last 20 of 143 films and all 6 series, newest first", and where to change it.

Changed:

- Newest first: films and series are listed by when they were added to Jellyfin, newest first.

### For Jellyfin 12

Added:

- Titles with audio description: a page beside Settings, chosen from the tabs at the top of both pages, that lists every film and every described episode, by series, from the tags Find and tag gives. Films have their year, described track and status; each series has how many of its episodes are described, such as 3 of 6 episodes described, and its episodes in order. Show All, Films or Series, each with its count. Each title opens its page in Jellyfin. The same page, columns and words as in the Starboard plug-in.

Fixed:

- Later Jellyfin 10.11 releases, such as 10.11.11: the settings page loads again. They changed how a plug-in asks for the list of people, so the page could not show its figures, people or tracks.

### For Jellyfin 10.11

Added:

- Titles with audio description: a page beside Settings, chosen from the tabs at the top of both pages, that lists every film and every described episode, by series, from the tags Find and tag gives. Films have their year, described track and status; each series has how many of its episodes are described, such as 3 of 6 episodes described, and its episodes in order. Show All, Films or Series, each with its count. Each title opens its page in Jellyfin. The same page, columns and words as in the Starboard plug-in.

Fixed:

- Later Jellyfin 10.11 releases, such as 10.11.11: the settings page loads again. They changed how a plug-in asks for the list of people, so the page could not show its figures, people or tracks.

### For Jellyfin 12

Added:

- Find and tag: every night at 04:20 and after each library scan, each film and episode with a described sound track, and its series, gets the tag Audio description, and the tag comes off when the track goes. Every Jellyfin app, televisions included, can filter by it.
- The Audio description collection: active by default, the films and series with a described track are in one collection.
- Play the described track: for each person ticked on the settings page, inactive until chosen. When they start a title with a described track and another track plays, Jellyfin asks their app to change to it. Not every app accepts this; the log says when one does not.
- Add a track you have: a description track in the folder, or uploaded on the settings page, is matched to its film or episode by its name, its length compared with the film's, and added next to the film as English (Audio Description) when they agree within 5 seconds. The sound is copied without converting it, with Jellyfin's own ffmpeg. Yes and No on the settings page put the original away or take the track off. Nothing is ever deleted.

name: Picture shrinker
overview: Shrinks the posters, backdrops, logos, photos of people and other pictures Jellyfin keeps, so they take less space.
description: Posters to 900 pixels tall, backdrops to 1,920 wide, photos of cast and crew to 400 wide and the other picture types to their own sizes, on the schedule you choose. Each smaller copy is checked before it replaces the original, and you choose whether the originals are backed up first.

versions.changelog:
### For Jellyfin 12

**After you install or update it, choose a backup option, or nothing is shrunk.** Open Dashboard, Plugins, Picture shrinker, then Settings. Under Original pictures, choose Keep a backup copy of each original or Shrink without a backup, then Save. There is no default.

---

Wording from the design system audit of 17
November 2026.

Changed:

- Shrink without a backup: the backup choice that keeps no copy of the originals has this name. Under Original pictures, the two choices are Keep a backup copy of each original and Shrink without a backup. A choice you already made is kept.
- Clearer wording on the settings page: Shrink all picture types says Active and Deactivate, each part of the page is named instead of "above" or "below", the warning and the notice start with what they are, and the two confirmation dialogs put their main button first.
- The time of the last save: after Save, the settings page says when it saved, such as "Saved at 16:31".
- A plain reason when a backup copy fails: a picture that is not shrunk because its original could not be copied says to check that Jellyfin can write to the backup folder, then gives the technical details.

Choose a backup option after you install or update, or nothing is shrunk. Open Dashboard, Plugins, Picture shrinker, then Settings. Under Original pictures, choose Keep a backup copy of each original or Just shrink, with no backup, then save. Updating from 1.1 asks again; a backup you already have is kept.

Added:

- A reminder in the Activity list: until you choose, Jellyfin's Dashboard shows "Picture shrinker is waiting for you to choose" in its Activity list when Jellyfin starts, and again at most once a day when a run or a new picture is skipped. Jellyfin has no way for a plug-in to show a pop-up, so this is where an administrator sees it. Once you choose, it writes nothing there.

Changed:

- Shrink pictures shows as failed until you choose: in Scheduled Tasks, the task ends as failed with the reason, instead of looking as if it worked. A finished run still sends no notification.

### For Jellyfin 12

**After you install or update it, choose a backup option, or nothing is shrunk.** Open Dashboard, Plugins, Picture shrinker, then Settings. Under Original pictures, choose Keep a backup copy of each original or Shrink without a backup, then Save. There is no default.

---

Added:

- All picture types, each on by default, with Shrink all picture types; backdrops asked for by Lentzeris in issue #2. Besides posters and photos of people, it now shrinks backdrops (1,920 pixels wide), thumbnails (1,280), logos (800), banners (1,000), disc art (500) and clear art (800), each with its own size. Shrink all picture types, on by default, shrinks every type; turn it off to tick the types yourself. PNG pictures such as logos keep their transparency.
- Choose the backup: Original pictures on the settings page has two choices, Keep a backup copy of each original and Just shrink, with no backup, and no default. Nothing is shrunk until you choose: a scheduled run, a new picture and Shrink now each say so, and the settings page shows a notice. Restore, Delete backup and Start again still work.
- After the update from 1.1: the old on and off backup setting is no longer used, so you choose again. A backup you already have is kept whichever you choose.
- Start again: the pictures it shrinks: deletes the backup and the records (your choice of backup is kept), moves each picture of every type it shrinks aside, whatever is ticked, and has Jellyfin download it again at full size. The old picture is kept until Jellyfin has a new one, and put back after a day if it has none.
- Start again: every picture: deletes the backup and the records, and has Jellyfin replace every picture of each library and each person, backdrops and logos included.
- Space saved says how many pictures are waiting for Jellyfin, replaced and put back.

### For Jellyfin 12

The first version for Jellyfin, in two builds from the same
source: 1.1.1.0 for Jellyfin 12 (.NET 10) and 1.1.0.0 for Jellyfin 10.11 (.NET 9). Jellyfin installs the one for its
own version.

- Shrinks Jellyfin's pictures: posters to 900 pixels tall and photos of cast and crew to 400 pixels wide, both settings. Smaller pictures are left alone.
- Checked before it replaces: each smaller copy is written beside the original, opened again and decoded in full, and swapped in only when it has the right size and format and is smaller.
- Backup first: each original is copied to a backup folder before its first shrink. Restore original pictures puts them back; Delete backup frees the space when you are sure.
- When you choose: a task in Scheduled Tasks, every Sunday at 03:30 until you change it, at the lowest priority. New pictures can be shrunk soon after Jellyfin saves them (deactivated by default).
- Space: the pictures now, the backup and the space saved, on the settings page. A finished run sends no notification.
